title: Palantir Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
summary: The unchanged Q2 2026 Form 10-Q reports USD 1.935 billion quarterly revenue, USD 912 million GAAP operating income, USD 1.216 billion operating cash flow, USD 9.409 billion of cash and marketable securities, USD 1.794 billion of total liabilities, 2.403 billion shares outstanding, 2.569 billion diluted weighted-average shares, and USD 467 million of six-month stock compensation.
